operating_notes.text: Announced strategic collaboration with OpenAI to combine Codex with Infosys Topaz Fabric for enterprise AI adoption.
FY26 large deal TCV was $15 bn with 55% net new.
Ranked number one IT provider for Banking in Europe and Financial Services in Nordics by Whitelane Research
Appointed Nitin Paranjpe as Vice Chairman of the Board.
Completed acquisition of Optimum Healthcare IT, a Best in KLAS healthcare digital transformation firm
Infosys reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹178,650 Cr and net profit of ₹29,474 Cr with an unmodified audit opinion.
Infosys launched Editorial Link Intelligence (ELI) in partnership with Handelsblatt Media Group.
Infosys expanded strategic collaboration with DNB Bank ASA to modernize Financial Crime operations using the NICE Actimize X-Sight platform.
Infosys launched AI-driven match and fan experiences with the Lawn Tennis Association.
AI services were 5.5% of revenue (~US$1 bn annualised) as of Q3FY26, with 90% of top 200 clients engaged on AI and over 4,800 AI projects.
FY26 large deal TCV was US$14.9 bn, 55% net new, up 24% from the previous year.
Employee count was 328,000 as of March end, with over 20,000 college graduates recruited in FY26.
AI services revenue was 8.2% of Q1FY27 revenue, up from 5.5% in Q3FY26, growing double-digit QoQ.
Large deal TCV was $3.6 bn with 61% net new; 22 large deals won, including three worth $400 mn each.
Utilisation excluding trainees improved 1.9% to 84.9%; DSO fell 4 days to 63.
Expanded collaboration with Truist to scale its AI-first GCC in Hyderabad, onboarding over 1,000 colleagues.

timeline.summary: Infosys announced a strategic collaboration with OpenAI on April 22, 2026, to integrate Codex with Infosys Topaz for enterprise AI transformation.
Infosys submitted the independent auditor reports with UDIN for the standalone and consolidated financial statements for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026.
Infosys announced FY26 revenue growth of 3.1% CC and guided for FY27 revenue growth of 1.5% to 3.5% CC with operating margins of 20% to 22%.
Infosys ranked as number one IT services provider for Banking in Europe and Financial Services in Nordics by Whitelane Research
Infosys appointed Nitin Paranjpe as Vice Chairman, approved the promoter reclassification of Shreyas Shibulal and Bhairavi Madhusudhan Shibulal, and allotted 35,384 shares under RSUs.
Infosys completes acquisition of Optimum Healthcare IT, a healthcare digital transformation company
Infosys announced postal ballot voting results for the appointment and re-appointment of independent directors on May 26, 2026.
Infosys filed its Integrated Annual Report for FY25-26, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹178,650 Cr and PAT of ₹29,474 Cr with an unmodified audit opinion.
Infosys filed a revised FY26 Integrated Annual Report to include an omitted explanatory statement for the 45th AGM notice.
Infosys announced the launch of Editorial Link Intelligence in partnership with Handelsblatt Media Group on June 2, 2026.
Infosys expanded its strategic collaboration with DNB Bank ASA on June 2, 2026, to modernize financial crime operations using the NICE Actimize X-Sight platform.
Infosys announced the launch of AI-driven fan experiences with the Lawn Tennis Association for the grass court season on June 3, 2026.
Infosys’ Satish H.C., Mohammed Rafee Tarafdar, and Sandeep Mahindroo to attend CLSA India’s GenAI Access Days virtual conference on June 15, 2026.
Infosys held its 45th AGM on June 23, 2026, reaffirming FY27 guidance of 1.5-3.5% constant-currency growth and 20-22% margin, and disclosing AI services at 5.5% of revenue.
Infosys cut FY27 constant-currency revenue growth guidance to 1.5-3% and named Ashiss Dash as CEO-designate to succeed Salil Parekh from April 1, 2027.
Infosys expanded its strategic collaboration with Truist to scale its AI-first Global Capability Center in Hyderabad with over 1,000 onboarded professionals.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹49,244 Cr (+10.7% YoY), net profit ₹7,838 Cr (+6.3% YoY).

status_history.evidence: Q1 constant currency growth was 2.4% YoY; FY27 guidance cut to 1.5-3%.

watchlist.response: Salil Parekh: 'it is something we look at internally, but it is not something we share externally.' Evasive.
watchlist.text: How much of the existing backlog has been re-priced under higher AI productivity, and how long will compression last?

watchlist.response: Salil Parekh: 'we do not quantify that compression part externally, but we acknowledge of course there is a compression.' Evasive.
watchlist.text: Can you quantify the AI-led deflation?

watchlist.response: Salil Parekh: 'we do not have a view in that sense externally' but pointed to digital's path from 20% to 60% of revenue.
watchlist.text: At what size of portfolio will AI revenues offset AI deflation?
